+title: 'OTel 5: replace os.Logger with swift-log in Transcripts, Configuration and Instructions, and guard against os.Logger'
+---
+## What
+Design item 2: remove all `os.Logger` use. This task changes the last 3 of the 11 `os.Logger` sites, and adds a guard test so that no new `os.Logger` or `OSSignposter` comes back. Approved design: `/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-wballard-github-swissarmyhammer/9f4fa2e8-6833-46c6-bb95-5091ae3613fa/scratchpad/otel-design.md`.
+
+Sites:
+- [ ] `Sources/FoundationModelsACPAgent/Transcripts/JSONLines.swift` — `transcriptLogger` (category `Transcripts`). `SessionIndex.swift` and `ProjectRegistry.swift` call it; the call sites change only if the call shape changes.
+- [ ] `Sources/FoundationModelsACPAgent/Configuration/ConfigurationLoader.swift` — `configurationLogger` (category `Configuration`).
+- [ ] `Sources/FoundationModelsACPAgent/Instructions/InstructionsAssembler.swift` — `instructionsLogger` (category `Instructions`).
+
+Rules (the same rules as OTel 3): `import Logging`, `Logger(label: "FoundationModelsACPAgent.<Category>")`, the same level, a fixed message, identifiers in metadata with keys from `ACPAgentTelemetry.LogMetadataKey`. A file path is safe; file content is not (design item 4). A configuration value is not safe: log the section name or key, never the value.
+
+- [ ] Add a guard test that reads each `.swift` file under `Sources/` and fails when a file contains `import os`, `os.Logger`, `Logger(subsystem:` or `OSSignposter`. Use `PackageRoot` from `Tests/FoundationModelsACPAgentTests/Support/PackageRoot.swift` to find `Sources/`.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] No file under `Sources/` has `import os`, `os.Logger`, `Logger(subsystem:` or `OSSignposter`.
+- [ ] An unknown configuration section writes one `.warning` record with the label `FoundationModelsACPAgent.Configuration` and the section name in metadata.
+- [ ] The guard test fails when a file under `Sources/` has `import os` (check this one time by hand in the red step of `/tdd`, then remove the line).
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Add `Tests/FoundationModelsACPAgentTests/NoUnifiedLoggingTests.swift` with the guard test.
+- [ ] Add a case to `Tests/FoundationModelsACPAgentTests/ConfigurationLoaderTests.swift` that loads a `config.yaml` with an unknown section and asserts the recorded warning (use the recorder from OTel 3).
+- [ ] Run `swift test --filter "NoUnifiedLoggingTests|ConfigurationLoaderTests"`. Expected: pass.
+- [ ] Run `swift test`. Expected: all tests pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #otel
\ No newline at end of file
